method: Viewed the five existing full-resolution native game captures during resumed closeout; no new game, computer control or input was used.

captures.observation: World map is populated, GER red, FRA/LLU blue, other countries grey and ZZZ black with red external borders; no all-red or blank-map initialization regression.

SOV detail displays the country-coloured core territory and internal state boundaries, including subdivided Siberia; country information and autonomous pie are visible. Runtime logs report 211 owned core states.
Mongolian detail displays a centred outline and the new internal divisions with its country colour and autonomous pie. Runtime logs report 18 owned core states.
Iraqi detail displays the country outline and subdivided states with its country colour, information and autonomous pie. Runtime logs report 16 owned core states.
Returning from detail restores the world map; the map rectangle matches the first world capture exactly in the separate pixel audit.

limitations: These captures validate the cold-war world/detail/return presentation; they do not assert manual mouse interaction, every zoom level or unrelated main-map visual fixes.
The existing error counter is not zero: the final runtime has 622 log lines, no map/cold-war errors and no new error signatures compared with the previous completed runtime.
